verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Teams Export APIs that can pull 1:1, group, meeting and channel messages (including messages deleted by users, retrievable up to 21 days) which supports eDiscovery-style data collection, but there is no documentation in the pack of actual retention policy configuration or legal hold enforcement mechanisms (e.g., Purview retention labels/holds). Missing for 10: explicit retention policy management docs, legal hold configuration/enforcement, admin center compliance controls, and independent verification of hold behavior.
